title: Wool With Outline
description: This Texture Pack Adds Outline on Wool Blocks
body:
This Texture Pack Adds Wool Block Outline,The Outline Color Is a Litle Bit Darker Than The Block Color,The Colors of Wool This Texture Pack Suppports are:Light Gray,Gray,Black,Brown,Red,Orange,Yellow,Lime,White,Pink,
Magenta,Purple,Blue,Light Blue,Cyan And Green
